concept: Telling the truth even when a small lie would be easier
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short scenario where a character accidentally breaks something and must choose whether to admit it
exercise.reflection_prompt: How do you think the character felt before and after telling the truth?
exercise.practice: Student roleplays both the honest and dishonest response with the mentor persona

assessment.success_marker: student can articulate the difference in how each choice feels, without being told which is 'right'
